correctness.rationale: The exact published Valentiner matrix generators reduce modulo 19 to 45 distinct projective lines. Exhaustive enumeration of 990 pair intersections yields precisely 201 reduced points in the same 120/45/36 multiplicity profile as the 201 complex points documented in arXiv:1407.2966 and arXiv:1609.08648; distinct-point equality proves the complex incidence table survives reduction. The resulting connected stable graph has 246 vertices, 720 edges and genus 475. Exact integer annihilating-polynomial and projector identities certify the Laplacian factorization. The independent 44-by-44 Bareiss determinant, 24 independently rooted prime-local Smith reductions across p=2,3,5,7,19,47, and all valuation/product divisibility checks reproduce exactly the group and its order. The geometric Jacobian statement is conditional on a proper regular split semistable smoothing with unit node thickness, under Néron Models §9.6.

value.rationale: Blowing up every singular point of the classical highly symmetric Wiman arrangement selects an intrinsic stable curve boundary rather than an arbitrary graph slice. Its 246-vertex complete integral graph critical group refines the known 201-point incidence data and rational spectrum, detects 7-, 19- and 47-primary torsion and distinct 3-power layers, and supplies an exact semistable Jacobian component-group invariant when the standard geometric hypotheses hold. The full spectrum and exact integer decomposition have direct use in degeneration arithmetic.
